page.overview:
Who is Melo?

Melo is a major character in Final Fantasy Brave Exvius debuting in Season Three as an antagonist and member of the Hollow Keepers.

Melo is a fair-skinned man with short brown hair. He wears a white coat with emeralds on his shoulders and black pants. For combat he wields a pair of black tomfas, adorned with green jewels.

Melo is laid back and lazy. He believes hard tasks to be a pain but is willing to do some for his own goals of creating a world without magic.
